page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.4xlarge is a memory-optimized instance type deployed on the KVM hypervisor. Powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz, the server provides 16 dedicated virtual CPUs. The memory configuration offers 128.0 GB of total RAM, translating to an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio, which aligns with memory-heavy system configurations.

The hardware design contains no local storage volumes and no discrete GPU accelerators. All persistent disk input and output rely exclusively on external network-attached block devices. Network communication provides a baseline throughput of 5 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are provisioned by default.

From an architectural perspective, the high memory-to-vCPU ratio yields qualitative resource efficiency for setups where memory exhaustion would otherwise occur before compute saturation. The absence of local solid-state drives requires careful planning for disk I/O over network fabrics. Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.4xlarge is suitable for in-memory databases, large caching layers, data processing frameworks, and enterprise business applications.
